name: Elementify Addons for Elementor
author: ElementifyWP

sections.description:
Elementify Addons for Elementor is a powerful and lightweight extension designed to supercharge your Elementor Page Builder. Packed with a collection of creative and fully customizable widgets, it helps you build faster and design smarter—just like a pro. Whether you’re crafting landing pages, blogs, or business websites, Elementify Addons for Elementor makes it easy to create stunning layouts with minimal effort and maximum flexibility.

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/elementifywp/elementify-addons-for-elementor

Fully Customizable

Every widget and extension offers extensive customization options, allowing you to tailor your website to your exact vision. Bring any design idea to life with ease.

Lightweight & Blazing Fast

Enjoy seamless performance with optimized code—no unnecessary bloat or slow-loading scripts. Experience instant loading and smooth live editing.

Granular Element Control

Fine-tune your site’s performance by enabling or disabling individual elements. Keep your pages lean and fast by deactivating unused widgets.

Dedicated Expert Support

Our top-tier support team is here to assist you. Get help anytime via our support forum, live chat, or contact form for quick, reliable solutions.

Elementor Website Builder is required for this plugin.

6+ FREE ADDONS & MORE COMING

Boost your Elementor designs with our ever-growing library of free widgets—crafted to expand your creative potential. Stay tuned for even more!

  1. [Animated Text] – Grab attention with dynamic, eye-catching text animations that boost engagement and visual interest
  2. [Advance Tab] – Display content in organized, interactive tabs — perfect for FAQs, comparisons, or multi-step content
  3. [Testimonial Carousel] – Showcase customer reviews in a stylish, rotating slider. Builds trust and adds social proof with ease
  4. [Logos Carousel] – Display brand logos, client badges, or media mentions with smooth, responsive scrolling
  5. [Advance Portfolio] – Create stunning, filterable portfolios with custom layouts — ideal for creatives, agencies, and freelancers
  6. [Advance Form] – Build stylish, flexible forms with custom fields, validation, and full Elementor styling — no extra plugins required

Documentation and Support

  • If you have any more questions, visit our support on the Plugin’s Forum.
  • For more information about features, FAQs and documentation, check out our website at Elementify Addons for Elementor.

sections.installation:
Note : This plugin works with Elementor. Make sure you have Elementor installed.

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. You can type “Elementify” on your element tabs within Elementor editor and all the available elements will appear.
  4. Also you can see them under the category “Elementify Addons” on your element/widget list.
sections.faq:
Can I use the plugin without Elementor Page Builder?

No. You cannot use without Elementor since it’s an addon for Elementor.

Does it work with any theme?

Absolutely! It will work with any theme where Elementor works.
